Scripts printed by upstream's `reims-ctl command` (reims-vgpu 1fe0acb, reims-ctl 0.1.0) for a VM
created in a throwaway container with `--dir "/tmp/h/vms/my mac"`: `default.sh` as created,
`custom.sh` after `set --logs true --extra-args ... --env ...`, `daemonize.sh` and `pidfile.sh`
with those extra args. Tests replace the QEMU path and the VM folder.
